en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 0.91 percent lower at 23294.75
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks ended lower on Wednesday as JD Health fell more than 15 percent after results, with main board turnover of about HK$177 billion.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 0.91 percent lower at 23,294.75 points on Wednesday, down 213 points, according to market data.
The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index fell 0.86 percent to 7,836.27 and the Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 0.58 percent to 3,736.33. Main board turnover was about HK$177 billion.
JD Health led declines among blue chips, falling about 15 percent after earnings, while Lenovo Group rose more than 4 percent. Gold mining shares also came under pressure as gold prices fell.

zh.headline: 恒生指數低收0.91% 報政23294.75點
zh.dek: 港股周三低收，京東健康績後挫超15%，主板成交額約1771億元。
body: 恒生指數周三收市報政23294.75點，跌213點或0.91%。
國企指數跌0.86%報政7836.27點，科技指數跌0.58%報政3736.33點。主板成交額約1771億元。
京東健康績後挫約15%，為藍籌中表現最差之一；聯想集團則升超4%。金礦股亦隨金價下跌而受壓。
更正：中文版本文字已更正。
